title: Orphan Games: Atari 7800 in the FPGA
summary: The Atari 7800 rebuilt in the FPGA (MiSTer's Atari7800 core by Jamie Blanks, MIT: SALLY 6502, MARIA graphics, TIA sound, RIOT, the 7800 cart mappers and POKEY sound). .a78 carts up to 128 KB, no BIOS needed. Play in the browser (keyboard or a USB gamepad) or on an ORPHAN Remote (CYD) screen. Real NES pads on the hashboard connectors work as joysticks 1 and 2 (A = left fire, B = right fire, Select, Start = RESET), through the same small 3.3 V adapter as the NES; disconnect every hashboard first. 2600 carts play on Orphan's Atari 2600 core. Free homebrew only. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.

slots.1: Atari 7800 (cart, frame buffer, sound, joysticks, real NES pads on J1..J9)
